record.question: What exact segment traversal connects each remaining published Lassen trailhead and destination, including shared junctions and alternatives?
record.reason: Wayproof publishes complete, bidirectional, distance-bearing trailhead-to-summit approaches for Lassen Peak and Brokeoff Mountain, plus a bounded summit approach for Cinder Cone; a connected distance-bearing parking-to-basin-entry graph for Bumpass Hell; and the atomic shared approach plus around-lake network for Boiling Springs Lake. Cinder Cone rim/crater circulation and the full Bumpass basin circulation remain explicit route-specific gaps. It also publishes ordered, bidirectional Warner Valley topology for Devils Kitchen and Terminal Geyser, but atomic leg distances remain unknown where route descriptions print only cumulative positions. These remaining questions still require route-specific reconciliation.
